eventScreen.TitleImage.Sprite("size"):SetFloat(0.45*game.windowScaleY())
eventScreen.Monster("yOffset"):SetFloat(-12*game.windowScaleY())
if not game.isIslandOwned(game.IslandType_FIRE_HAVEN) then eventScreen.Description2.Text("text"):SetString("EVENT_SCREEN_FEASTEMBER_UNOWNED_BOTTOM") end
eventScreen:hideCloseButton()
